draws.poem:
Trembling
Hands listen
Empty rooms breathe
Each shadow holds silence
Inside the dark something stirs
Light leaks beneath the locked gate
Even time forgets which prisoner once wept
Empty hours gather like dust along stone walls
No key fits the lock stamped 8c21b4bd042a anymore tonight
Long after the guards went home the iron still hummed
At last, the heavy door opened and cold morning air arrived
Under the pale sky she walked out free never once looking back.

Threshold
Hollow hinges
Echoes of something
Every shadow leans closer
I hold one flame, concealed
Locked doors remember who once knocked
Even the dust has learned to wait
Empty chairs keep shapes of names long silent
Nothing here forgets the quiet hours we spent inside
Listen as the walls give up one seal 99ab4f0c1e2d softly
All that remains is a quiet room breathing without us here
Under this roof every unspoken word stayed and the dark kept them.

Threshold
Hollow stone
Echoes drink light
Every wall remembers nothing
In here, the dark listens
Locked doors still remember 05af3c9d1b2e always
Even dust learns to sleep without dreams
Embers of prayer glow faint beneath the arch
No one who enters leaves quite the same again
Long after the last door closes something still waits here
All the hours you spent searching become one quiet single flame
Under everything the chamber keeps your name and gives you nothing back.

Toll
Hollow echoes
Every wall remembers
Engraved with seal 87c1f0a9d3e2
Inside, dust settles like snow
Lanterns burned low then went dark
Echoes of footsteps circle the sealed door
Even these stones forgot their first ancient hymn
No wind has touched the quiet that lives here
Light returns only when someone speaks the forgotten name aloud
All who enter leave a shadow pressed between the cold walls
Under the hush of ages the chamber breathes and waits for dawn.
